name: Delivery Pipeline Section Contract
purpose: Visualize the 8-phase P0-P8 software delivery lifecycle governed by strict entry and exit criteria.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.title: Delivery Pipeline (P0–P8)
components.description: Deterministic phase transitions with automated validation at every boundary.

steps.title: Intake & Scope Lock
steps.desc: Requirements converted to immutable scope contract and parent Epic.

steps.title: Architecture & Design
steps.desc: TL drafts TDR; Designer produces tokenized Design Contract.

steps.title: Test-First Build
steps.desc: Dev agents implement test-first; all PRs capped at ≤ 400 LOC.

steps.title: Dual Parallel Review
steps.desc: Independent approval from TL (architecture) and QA (test completeness).

steps.title: Automated Deploy & Acceptance
steps.desc: Promotion to staging, headless E2E verification, manager-gated release.

data.role: Human locks business goals; AI structures scope & writes specs
AI drafts modular contracts; Human Architect approves
AI writes production code in small PRs; Human spot-checks
AI writes mock fixtures, edge tests, and regression tests
AI scripts Playwright/headless tests; Human validates visual fidelity
AI configures containers & pipelines; Human controls deploy gate

states.default: Continuous track connecting phases with glowing status nodes.
states.hover: Hovering over phase card emphasizes its inputs, deliverables, and automated gates.

responsive.desktop: Horizontal 5-step process flow with connector bars; full comparison table.
responsive.mobile: Vertical accordion / step timeline; compact stat bars for AI/Human ratio.
